purpose: Find the smallest baryonic-map-only Haar budget that repairs the disclosed NGC6946 gas-detail failure without reading any holdout array or using a velocity or gravity residual for selection.
developmentDisclosure: P0748 is method development after the P0745-P0747 validation reveal. It may inform the final holdout protocol but is not a validation result. Selection uses only source-versus-generated baryonic-map scores and compression.

representation.padding: zero pad upper index edges to the next power-of-two square
representation.coefficientSelection: largest absolute coefficients with deterministic flat-index serialization
representation.reconstruction: inverse Haar, crop, clip negative ringing, and restore component mass
representation.selectionRule: Choose the smallest budget passing only the frozen baryonic morphology, mass, projection, and compression gates. Formula transport is reported downstream and is deliberately nonbinding in this scan.

claimBoundary: P0748 can develop a holdout rule but cannot be called validation because NGC3521 and NGC6946 targets were already revealed in P0746.
Velocity fields, formula residuals, and gravity parameters do not enter coefficient-budget selection.
The same rule must be frozen before any NGC2841 or NGC7331 pixel array is opened.
